Quick update: our offsite schedule just shifted unexpectedly. The execs added a client site visit on Sep 17 and a prep session on Sep 16 morning, so our on-site availability narrowed. Two options from our side now:

A) Move the demo earlier to Tue Sep 15 — ideally 2pm as you suggested, but we may only be able to host from 2:30–4:00pm due to prep.
B) Keep Sep 17 but run a remote session (60m) — execs will be traveling but can join via a single conference room.

We prefer option A if Redwood can still be onsite that afternoon. If not, we can do the remote option on Sep 17 at 10am PT. Sorry for the last-minute churn — let me know what you can make work.

Thanks,
